reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[RFC-0010] Add workload identity support for remote clusters by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5434", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The release note announces a new additive capability (workload identity for remote clusters) and states no change to existing behavior, so an operator has no forced action or breakage implied by this item.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds workload identity support for remote clusters (RFC-0010) as a new capability.
